latzug: She performs slow controlled lat pulldowns with perfect form: chest lifted, slight lean back, she pulls the wide bar down to her upper chest leading with the elbows, squeezes her shoulder blades, then lets the bar rise slowly back to full arm extension. Smooth steady reps, no swinging. Static camera from the side.

She keeps doing slow lat pulldowns with perfect form, bar to the upper chest and back up to full extension, then after the last rep she lets the bar up and looks into the camera with a confident smile. Static camera from the side.
rudern: She performs seated cable rows with perfect form: torso stays upright and still, she pulls the handle to her lower stomach with elbows close to the body, squeezes her shoulder blades together, then extends her arms slowly. No rocking. Static camera from the side.

She continues smooth seated cable rows, upright torso, handle to the stomach and slowly back, then on the last rep she holds the squeeze and glances at the camera with a determined look. Static camera from the side.
beinpresse: She performs controlled leg press reps: she pushes the platform up through her heels until her legs are almost straight without locking the knees, then lowers it slowly until her knees are bent about 90 degrees, knees tracking over the toes, back flat on the pad. Static camera from the side.

She continues controlled leg press reps with steady tempo, never locking her knees, back flat on the pad, breathing hard, then finishes and looks at the camera with a tough smile. Static camera from the side.
kniebeuge: She performs barbell back squats with perfect form: braces her core, sits her hips back and down until her thighs are just below parallel, knees tracking over her toes, heels flat, chest up and back straight, then drives up to standing. Slow controlled reps. Static camera, three-quarter view.
She continues barbell back squats with perfect depth and a straight back, slow on the way down and powerful on the way up, then stands tall and nods at the camera. Static camera, three-quarter view.
rdl: She performs Romanian deadlifts with perfect form: soft knees, she hinges at the hips pushing them back, keeps her back flat and the bar sliding close along her legs down to mid-shin, then squeezes her glutes and stands tall. Slow controlled tempo. Static camera from the side.

She continues Romanian deadlifts with a flat back and the bar close to her legs, slow hinge down and strong stand up, then after the last rep she stands tall and looks at the camera. Static camera from the side.
bankdruecken: She performs dumbbell bench presses with perfect form: shoulder blades pulled back, she lowers the dumbbells slowly to chest level with elbows at about 45 degrees, then presses them back up over her chest. Controlled reps, feet planted. Static camera from the side.
She continues smooth dumbbell bench presses, slow down and strong up, then sets the dumbbells on her thighs, sits up and looks at the camera with a confident smile. Static camera from the side.
schulterdruecken: She performs seated dumbbell shoulder presses with perfect form: back against the pad, core braced, she presses the dumbbells overhead until her arms are straight, then lowers them slowly back to shoulder height. No arching. Static camera, three-quarter front view.
She continues strict seated shoulder presses with steady tempo, then lowers the dumbbells to her thighs and gives the camera a confident look. Static camera, three-quarter front view.
seitheben: She performs lateral raises with perfect form: slight bend in the elbows, she raises the dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height, pauses briefly, then lowers them slowly. Shoulders down, no swinging. Static camera from the front.
She keeps doing slow strict lateral raises to shoulder height, then lowers the dumbbells and smiles into the camera. Static camera from the front.
beinstrecker: She performs leg extensions with perfect form: back against the pad, she extends her legs until they are straight, squeezes her thighs for a moment, then lowers the weight slowly. Controlled tempo. Static camera from the side.
She continues slow leg extensions with a hold at the top, then finishes the set and looks at the camera with a fierce smile. Static camera from the side.
trizeps: She performs triceps rope pushdowns with perfect form: elbows pinned to her sides, she pushes the rope down until her arms are fully straight, spreads the rope apart at the bottom, then returns slowly. Upper arms stay still. Static camera from the side.
She continues strict triceps rope pushdowns, elbows locked at her sides, then lets go of the rope and flexes her arm toward the camera with a playful smile. Static camera from the side.
hipthrust: She performs barbell hip thrusts with perfect form: chin tucked, she drives through her heels and lifts her hips until her torso is parallel to the floor, pauses at the top, then lowers slowly. Controlled reps. Static camera from the side, full body in view.

She continues controlled barbell hip thrusts with a pause at the top, chin tucked, then rests the bar and looks at the camera with a determined expression. Static camera from the side, full body in view.
ausfallschritte: She performs walking lunges holding dumbbells with perfect form: long step forward, back knee lowers close to the floor, front knee stays over the ankle, torso upright, then she steps through into the next lunge. Camera follows slowly.
She keeps doing walking lunges toward the camera with an upright torso and controlled steps, then stops, stands tall and gives the camera a confident smile. Camera follows slowly.
kettlebell: She performs kettlebell swings with perfect form: she hikes the kettlebell back between her legs, then snaps her hips forward to swing it to chest height with straight arms, back flat, core tight, standing tall at the top. Powerful rhythmic reps. Static camera from the side.
She continues powerful kettlebell swings driven by the hips, flat back, then parks the kettlebell on the floor and looks at the camera breathing hard with a smile. Static camera from the side.
kabelzug_fly: She performs standing cable chest flyes with perfect form: slight bend in the elbows, she brings the handles together in a wide hugging arc in front of her chest, squeezes, then opens her arms slowly back out. Controlled reps, stable stance. Static camera from the front.
She continues slow cable flyes with a squeeze in the middle, then releases the handles and looks into the camera with a confident smirk. Static camera from the front.
